summary: Tuba City Airport is a small public-use general aviation facility serving the Navajo Nation community of Tuba City in northern Arizona. Located along U.S. Route 160, it primarily supports private and charter aircraft and provides convenient access to nearby natural landmarks including the Painted Desert, Monument Valley, and the eastern entrance to Grand Canyon National Park.
